one_line_summary: Rodrigo Castillo (Head of Operations) is looking to scale autonomous drone inspections across three Atacama sites, leveraging existing success with FlytBase to meet Q3 budget goals.

buyer_context.who: Rodrigo Castillo, Head of Operations, Northern Operations Division
what_he_cares_about: Reducing costs of contracted inspection crews
Aligning operational expansion with the Salar Futuro project

others_involved.name_or_role: Rodrigo Toler (Deputy Manager of Digital Innovation)
others_involved.why: Existing internal champion who has already successfully implemented FlytBase at SQM [S40].

others_involved.name_or_role: Alberto Llona (General Manager, Lithium Division Chile)
others_involved.why: Likely reporting line for Rodrigo Castillo and a key stakeholder for budget approval.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM is an existing FlytBase customer with a proven track record of 4x iodine yield improvement and 95% mission reliability [S40].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Provides immediate social proof and a baseline for ROI to justify the Q3 budget expansion.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: The 'Salar Futuro' project is a $3 billion, 7-year modernization initiative [S10].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: This is the primary budget vehicle for scaling autonomous operations; align the pitch to this project's goals.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM targets 300k tons LCE capacity by 2027 and maintains a 'zero accident' safety mandate [S26, S36].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Positions the solution as a critical safety and efficiency enabler for their aggressive production growth.

recommended_case_study.title: How SQM Turned a 678 km² Mine into an Autonomous Inspection Zone
recommended_case_study.why: It validates the exact solution for their specific sites and provides the metrics needed to build the internal business case.

gtm_motion: AE-led co-sell with Dronestore Chile (Gold System Integrator).

suggested_next_step.action: Schedule a discovery call with Rodrigo Castillo and Dronestore Chile to map the internal procurement process for Q3.
suggested_next_step.rationale: The lead is a P1 priority; immediate engagement is required to influence the Q3 budget planning and leverage the existing internal champion.

watch_outs: The complexity of the Nova Andino Litio joint venture may add layers to procurement.
Ensure the conversation remains sensitive to indigenous land rights and non-intrusive operational requirements [S32].
Verify if Rodrigo has final budget authority or if he needs a formal business case to present to the Lithium Division leadership.
